Desierto ORCID: orcid.org/0009-0004-4563-2754 4 Show authors Nature Water ( 2026 ) Cite this article Save article View saved research 125 Accesses 5 Altmetric Metrics details The human right to water is well established in law, but putting it into practice remains difficult across diverse hydrological, social and governance contexts. A proactive, contextual approach can link water-security and governance conditions to challenges in realizing the right. This can help to anticipate problems before harm occurs and strengthen existing due-diligence and stewardship processes.
